items.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018
items.q: Like if Robin Williams or Eddie Murphy came in then one of us would go on after them because nobody wanted to follow them type of thing.

ctx.x: So you wanted to be — I mean you aspired to go beyond that? Or did it just sort of happen?

No I mean I wanted to work. So probably in my early twenties I think, when I was starting to audition for shows and things like that in New York. I didn’t know what I wanted to do. I just knew, all right I had some Gospel. I was raised Presbyterian so I was not raised in the Baptist church, but I loved Gospel music. So I moved out to the west coast when I was in my teens, and one thing led to another and I was able to join a Gospel choir led by the great Reverend Daryl Coley, who was a star in the Gospel music…

his shows so he started doing HBO shows, so I was called to do that as a result of doing demos for Bob Stein, who is his musical director. So like all these things kind of started happening and then I started sitting in in bands in New York. And then I was doing weddings at the same time, meeting people, just meeting people. I said I don’t know what I’m doing but I’m just going to try to meet as many people as I can. So then I started singing at Catch a Rising Star comedy club in between comedians, many of whom…
